summary.conclusion: The gauge invariance R_odd(ℒ_Xg₀)=0 is proved exactly on the product. After A02's curvature correction, R^±=diag(1,0,0), so the first obstruction VANISHES on the kernel plane span{e₂,e₃}. K_adj≈-0.0354 remains a valid bilinear spectral response on this plane. The full Ozuch obstruction is a biquadratic form Q(ζ,ζ,ξ,ξ) with both isotropic and anisotropic parts. The next computation: decompose K_adj into the SO(2)-equivariant components of the biquadratic obstruction and determine whether the angular equation has a nontrivial solution on the kernel plane.
